name: A Heart Reborn , I Wish to Be a Stranger to You in This Life
overview:
Wen Sui Li was fortunate enough to be betrothed by the Emperor. She carefully held onto her fervent and passionate heart and happily married the handsome Fourth Prince, Ling Xiao. She thought they would live happily ever after, but little did she know that Ling Xiao already had someone else in his heart. Wen Sui Li suffered neglect and hardship and ultimately passed away. Reborn into a new life, she vows never to repeat the same mistakes.

(Source: Chinese = 红果短剧 app || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shang Bei Zi Ku Gou Le, Da Si Ta Dou Bu Jia Le" (上辈子苦够了，打死她都不嫁了), also known as "Wan Ning Zhuang" (绾凝妆), by Chang Qing Qing (常庆庆).
